input_messages.content: Hey there! So, I got a bit of a situation—I ended up with two tablets when I only needed one. I want to send back the pricier one and get my money back on my credit card. Can you help me sort this out?
Oh, I totally blanked on my email—sorry! But my name is Chen Silva and my zip code is 46281. Will that work?

Oh, I’m not great with order numbers—I always lose those! But I do remember that one of the tablets was a bit fancier, like, bigger screen and more storage, and it cost more. The other one was just a basic model. I got them both pretty recently, maybe last week? Can you check my recent orders and see which one is the more expensive tablet? That’s the one I want to send back.

Wait, what? I really wanted the refund to go back to my credit card, not a gift card! That’s super frustrating. Why can’t you just put it back on my card? Ugh, fine—I guess if there’s no other way, just refund it to the gift card. But I’m not happy about it! Can you at least make sure it’s a fast process?
Yeah, go ahead—let’s do it. Please send me the return instructions so I can get this tablet out of my hair. Thanks!

Awesome, thanks for helping me out! I’ll keep an eye out for that email. Have a good one! 

###STOP###
